name: Baked Striped Bass (Or White Fish)
description: A whole striped bass or white fish baked with garlic, mushrooms, and herbs, served with a rich butter sauce.
recipeIngredient: 3 to 4 lb whole striped bass, dressed and boned

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F and lightly butter a large, shallow baking pan.
Wash and pat dry the fish with paper towels. Sprinkle inside and outside with salt and pepper.
Place the fish in the baking pan and add the remaining ingredients except for the sauce ingredients.
Bake, basting frequently with the liquid in the pan, for 40 minutes or until the fish flakes easily with a fork.
Carefully remove the fish to a heated serving platter, cover, and keep warm.
To make the sauce, cook the pan liquid over medium heat until it reduces to 1 cup, about 15 to 20 minutes.
Blend 1 teaspoon of butter with flour and stir into the hot liquid. Bring to a boil and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Reduce heat and add the remaining butter, shaking the pan until melted. Remove from heat.
Serve the sauce with the fish.

keywords: baked fish, striped bass, white fish, herb butter sauce

_similar.name: Turkey A La King
_similar.description: A creamy turkey dish made with mushrooms, celery, and green pepper, served over toast or rice.

recipeInstructions.text: In a skillet, melt butter over medium heat. Add mushrooms, onion, celery, and green pepper. Cook until vegetables are tender.
Remove vegetables from skillet with a slotted spoon and set aside.
In the same skillet, blend flour into the butter to make a roux. Gradually add chicken broth and milk, stirring constantly.
Bring mixture to a boil and cook for 2 minutes, or until it thickens.
Add reserved turkey and vegetables to the sauce. Heat through.
Serve over hot toast, biscuits, or rice.

_similar.keywords: turkey a la king, creamy turkey, mushrooms, celery, green pepper

_similar.name: Chili Turkey
_similar.description: A hearty chili turkey dish made with ground turkey, kidney beans, and whole wheat spaghetti.

recipeInstructions.text: Heat oil in a large heavy pot over medium heat. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until it starts to brown, about 8 to 10 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the turkey and cook, stirring to coarsely crumble until no longer pink, about 8 to 10 minutes.
Stir in chili powder, tomato paste, broth, cinnamon, cumin, salt, coriander, and oregano. Bring to a simmer.
Partially cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until the meat is tender and the broth is slightly thickened.
Meanwhile, pour the beans (with juice) into a microwaveable bowl. Microwave on high for 1 to 2 minutes or until heated through. Drain and cover to keep warm.
Cook the pasta as directed.
Place pasta on a plate, ladle chili over pasta, and top with beans, then with cheese.

_similar.keywords: chili turkey, ground turkey, kidney beans, whole wheat spaghetti

_similar.name: Ken Noodle Supper
_similar.description: A hearty chicken and noodle supper with a creamy sauce, mixed vegetables, and a blend of herbs.
recipeIngredient: 1 pkg (10 oz/300 g) frozen mixed vegetables

recipeInstructions.text: Cut chicken into 1 inch cubes. Cook in butter in a large skillet over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Add onion, mushrooms, and garlic. Cook until onion is tender.
Stir in flour, salt, pepper, and herbs. Cook until thickens.
Gradually add milk, stirring constantly. Bring to a boil and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add mustard and noodles. Return to a boil.
Add frozen vegetables. Stir and cook for 10 minutes before serving.

_similar.keywords: chicken noodle supper, creamy sauce, comfort food

_similar.name: Lemon Chicken With Thyme
_similar.description: A flavorful chicken dish made with lemon juice, thyme, and a light flour coating, served with lemon wedges and parsley.
recipeIngredient: Lemon halves and chopped parsley for garnish (optional)

recipeInstructions.text: In a plastic bag, combine flour, salt, and pepper. Add chicken and shake to coat lightly.
In a large skillet, warm oil over medium heat. Brown chicken about 5 minutes each side. Transfer to a plate.
Coarsely chop the onion. Add margarine to the skillet and stir until softened, 2 to 3 minutes.
Stir in reserved flour and combine. Add chicken broth, lemon juice, and thyme. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly.
Return chicken to skillet, reduce heat to medium-low, and cover. Cook until chicken is tender, about 5 minutes.
Serve with lemon wedges and a sprinkling of parsley, if desired.
